lines.text: What you sow does not come to life unless it dies, and God gives each seed its own body.
Men, animals, birds and fish each have their own kind of flesh, and the sun, moon and stars differ in splendor.
The first man Adam became a living being, the last Adam a life-giving spirit, and the second man is from Eden.
We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed in the twinkling of an eye at the first trumpet.
The sting of death is sin, and thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
